lines.say: Heavy weights or light weights? Which builds more muscle?
In one study, one group lifted heavy, for eight to twelve reps.
The other went light, for twenty five to thirty five reps.
Both took their sets close to failure.
Muscle growth was about the same.
But the heavy group got stronger.
So for size, effort matters more than the weight. For strength, lift heavy.
Most people do well with a mix of rep ranges.
